reviews.feedback: internal/webhooks/webhooks.go:206-207 and 164-170: deliveries that are not sent (endpoint disabled by the 410, or event missing) still get d.Attempts++ and last_attempt_at set, and RunDue counts them in n. The task says RunDue returns how many attempts it made and that the other pending deliveries of a gone endpoint are not sent, so attempts/last_attempt_at/n overstate what happened (TestGoneDisablesEndpoint asserts n == 2 with only 1 request). Fix: when !sent, fail the delivery without incrementing Attempts or setting LastAttemptAt/ResponseStatus, and only count sent deliveries in RunDue's n; update the test's expected count to 1 and assert the skipped deliveries have no new attempt recorded.
